categories.safeRule: If commit was blocked atomically, say no project change was applied.
Differentiate unreadable, incompatible, corrupt, incomplete, writer-lock and read-only cases.
State whether changes remain in memory/current session and avoid calling it sync.
Always state local-save state separately when relevant.
Do not imply project corruption or capability absence.
Separate source file, staged/native project changes, and fidelity categories.
State original/backup retention and verification only if actually performed.
Name recovery source and what file/state was or was not modified.
Partial completion must list completed/incomplete work.
Proposal remains unapplied until explicit apply succeeds.
Give stable error code in details, not as the only user explanation.
